verdict.rationale: Card products can be physical or virtual (docs-33), and cards are created through the Core API from a user and card product (docs-24), which implies API-driven physical card issuance. The pack says nothing about personalization, fulfillment, or a managed manufacturer arrangement. Missing for 10: custom card art, bulk ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, managed card-manufacturer/fulfillment relationship, independent corroboration.
